functions.name: readNote
functions.description: Read HuNote headers from the copy of the message in a specific folder. Folder-scoped: no cross-folder fallback.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: TB account id of the folder containing the target message copy

parameters.name: folderPath
parameters.description: WebExtension folder path, e.g. '/INBOX' or '/[Gmail]/All Mail'

functions.name: writeNote
functions.description: APPEND a modified copy of the message with new HuNote headers, then delete original.

functions.name: deleteNote
functions.description: Strip all X-Hu-note* headers from message via APPEND-then-delete, clear msgHdr props on all copies.

functions.name: isImapFolder
functions.description: Return true if the folder containing this message is IMAP.

functions.name: isGmailFolder
functions.description: Return true if the folder's IMAP server is Gmail.
